subtitle: Mainstage
_sources: Handoffs/tech-packs/Fountain Square — Tech Pack DRAFT.md (2026-09-14), venue_email.py FSQ blocks, the FSQ load-in doc (Production Specifications 2026, Kayla Loree), CLAUDE.md venue table. Every item marked confirm is unverified; the build refuses --final while any remain.
intro: What 3CDC provides at Fountain Square, and what we need from you. Your advance email names your day-of contact; text or call them when you're about 5 minutes out.

items.label: Location
items.text: Mainstage, 520 Vine St, Cincinnati, OH 45202

items.label: Dimensions
items.text: W × D, height to roof

items.label: Cover
items.text: Covered stage (roof / canopy detail)

items.label: Drum riser
items.text: Available on request; ask on the advance form (size)

items.label: Backline
items.text: None. Artists provide all instruments, amps and 1/4" cables.

items.label: Engineer
items.text: 3CDC provides an engineer who mixes FOH and monitors from FOH. Bringing your own? Say so on the advance form.

items.label: FOH console
items.text: DiGiCo Quantum 225

items.label: Monitor console
items.text: Midas M32, on select events; otherwise monitors are mixed from FOH

items.label: PA
items.text: L-Acoustics: 4× A15 per side, 8× KS21 subs in a delayed arch

items.label: Monitors
items.text: 8× L-Acoustics X12 wedges

items.label: Monitor mixes
items.text: Maximum wedge mixes per act

items.label: In-ears
items.text: Bring your own IEM system; note it on the advance form

items.label: Microphones
items.text: House microphone inventory

items.label: DIs
items.text: DI count and type

items.label: Sound limit
items.text: Strict 95 dBA-Slow at the FOH position, city ordinance, for house and touring engineers alike. The house engineer may baffle amps to bring stage volume down.

items.label: Operator
items.text: 3CDC provides a house LD on every show. Lighting requests go on the advance form.

items.label: Stage power
items.text: Circuits and distro available on stage

items.label: Option 1
items.text: Temporarily park in the loading zone on 5th Street, next to the stage. Not a flat push: 4 steps, then flat.

items.label: Option 2
items.text: Temporarily park on 6th Street (paid city parking, not guaranteed open). Flat but long push through the connector to the stage ramp.

items.label: Time limit
items.text: 15 minutes to load or unload with either option.

items.label: Parking
items.text: Fountain Square Garage. We send one QR validation per vehicle after you advance; scan it at the kiosk on entry or exit and don't pay. Clearance 6'8"; note taller vehicles, trailers or buses on the form.

items.label: Details
items.text: The Load-In Information document attached to your welcome email has the maps.

items.label: Merch
items.text: You provide the seller, point of sale and bank. We provide a tent next to the stage with a table and chairs.

items.label: Dressing rooms
items.text: No indoor rooms. On request, a 10×10 tent with sidewalls for private band space.

items.label: Hospitality
items.text: Drink tickets and water for all performers and crew (third-party events: water only).

sections.title: House Rules
items: Family-friendly content only, including prerecorded tracks and sound check.
Stay on the stage: no crowd surfing, climbing or jumping off.
Nothing thrown or shot into the crowd.
Rain or shine; a lightning hold means clear the stage until the all-clear.
Payment after the performance. The full list is on the advance form.
